controls.title: Presumption against implicit authority
controls.description: Consequential action requires explicit authority and mandate.

controls.title: Registration duty
controls.description: Material system/principal must be registered.

controls.title: Repository backlink
controls.description: Governed repository/system must backlink canonical Conductellence authority.

controls.title: Inventory of material dependencies
controls.description: Material dependency inventory must exist.

controls.title: Discovery of shadow assets
controls.description: Discovered assets must be registered.

controls.title: Principal classes
controls.description: Principal class must be canonical.

controls.title: Identity is not authority
controls.description: Identity and authority must be separately represented.

controls.title: Model non-identity
controls.description: Model identity must not substitute for governed principal identity.

controls.title: Anti-impersonation
controls.description: Asserted and authenticated identity must match.

controls.title: Capability form
controls.description: Capability must be explicit and typed.

controls.title: Least privilege
controls.description: Requested capability must be a subset of granted capability.

controls.title: No self-escalation
controls.description: Artificial principals may not self-escalate or mutate authority.

controls.title: Delegation subset rule
controls.description: Delegation may not exceed delegator capability.

controls.title: Delegation provenance
controls.description: Delegation provenance must be reconstructable.

controls.title: Bounded recursion
controls.description: Delegation recursion must remain bounded.

controls.title: Non-transitive trust
controls.description: Trust is not automatically transitive through delegation.

controls.title: Human Personal Domain
controls.description: Non-human execution is denied against the Human Personal Domain.

controls.title: Boundary event
controls.description: Every boundary crossing must create a boundary event.

controls.title: Unknown boundary state
controls.description: Unknown boundary state fails closed.

controls.title: Dataset Passport
controls.description: Dataset admission requires an independent multidimensional passport.

controls.title: Retention and deletion authority
controls.description: Retention/deletion mutation requires explicit authority.

controls.title: Content-Authority Firewall
controls.description: Content may change knowledge state, never authority state.

controls.title: Memory is privileged persistence
controls.description: Memory write is privileged persistence.

controls.title: Cross-project memory
controls.description: Cross-project memory requires explicit authority.

controls.title: Model registration
controls.description: Models used in governed execution must be registered.

controls.title: Agent Manifest
controls.description: Agent Manifest is mandatory.

controls.title: Missing permission denies
controls.description: Missing permission denies.

controls.title: Inter-agent authentication
controls.description: Inter-agent calls require authenticated endpoints.

controls.title: Rogue-agent containment
controls.description: Rogue/compromised agents must be contained.

controls.title: Tool admission
controls.description: Tool use requires admission.

controls.title: Tool availability is not permission
controls.description: Tool availability is not permission.

controls.title: Egress control
controls.description: External egress requires destination and data clearance.

controls.title: Disable path
controls.description: Every admitted external execution path requires a disable path.

controls.title: Source and dependency inventory
controls.description: Source/dependency inventory is required.

controls.title: Build provenance
controls.description: Build provenance must identify source, builder and artifact.

controls.title: Dependency substitution
controls.description: Dependency substitution requires explicit approval.

controls.title: Credential isolation
controls.description: Credentials must be isolated to workload/scope.

controls.title: Credential inventory
controls.description: Credential inventory is mandatory.

controls.title: Secret prohibition
controls.description: Plaintext secrets are prohibited in governed code/evidence surfaces.

controls.title: Continuous authorization
controls.description: Authorization must be current at execution time.

controls.title: Mandatory gate sequence
controls.description: Required stage gates must pass before execution.

controls.title: Finite decision grammar
controls.description: Runtime decision must use finite grammar.

controls.title: Runtime policy mediation
controls.description: Runtime action requires policy mediation.

controls.title: Fail closed
controls.description: Evaluation error must fail closed.

controls.title: Policy pinning
controls.description: Decision must pin policy version and hash.

controls.title: Restrictive emergency overlay
controls.description: Emergency overlay may only restrict authority.

controls.title: Reconciliation
controls.description: Completed execution requires reconciliation.

controls.title: Scenario isolation
controls.description: Scenario execution must remain isolated from production/external effects.

controls.title: External-effect gate
controls.description: External effect requires release gate.

controls.title: Reversibility classification
controls.description: Consequential action requires reversibility classification.

controls.title: Revocation during execution
controls.description: Execution must remain revocable/observe current revocation state.

controls.title: SPETL requirement
controls.description: Consequential action requires SPETL evidence.

controls.title: Correlation and causation
controls.description: Trace events require correlation and causation identifiers.

controls.title: Append-oriented history
controls.description: Evidence history must be append-oriented.

controls.title: Trace directions
controls.description: Trace must reconstruct actor/action/resource/authority.

controls.title: No chain-of-thought requirement
controls.description: Auditability shall not require private chain-of-thought.

controls.title: Control binding
controls.description: Automatable law must bind to controls.

controls.title: Audit binding
controls.description: Automatable controls must bind to executable audits.

controls.title: Auditability state
controls.description: Every § requires valid auditability state.

controls.title: Regression of discovered failures
controls.description: Resolved failures require regression coverage.

controls.title: Severity grammar
controls.description: Findings must use finite severity grammar.

controls.title: Security Stop
controls.description: Security Stop cannot continue unrestricted execution.

controls.title: Exceptions
controls.description: Exceptions require identity, owner, scope, expiry and justification.

controls.title: Expired exception
controls.description: Expired exception cannot authorize action.

controls.title: Suspension
controls.description: Suspended systems cannot perform consequential execution.

controls.title: Orphan detection
controls.description: Active assets require owner and registration.

controls.title: Versioning
controls.description: Constitutional/policy artifacts require explicit semantic version.

controls.title: Regulatory and standards drift
controls.description: Regulatory/standards drift monitoring must remain active.

controls.title: Anti-bloat rule
controls.description: New §§ require distinct normative effect; implementation detail belongs below the Act.
